description:
The proposed development comprises the erection of a single storey rear extension with a flat roof and the construction of a first floor rear extension with a hipped roof form.

At ground floor level, the extension facilitates the creation of an enlarged open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, alongside a reconfigured existing layout into a utility room and WC. The rear elevation will incorporate bi-folding doors and high-level windows to improve natural light and access to the garden.

At first floor level, the proposal introduces an additional bedroom (Bedroom 04) and en-suite, with internal reconfiguration to improve the overall layout and functionality of the dwelling.

External alterations include the installation of new windows and doors to match the existing dwelling, the use of materials to match the existing house, and the incorporation of obscure glazing where required to the new bathroom window.

The proposed development has been designed to remain subordinate to the host dwelling and is in keeping with the character and appearance of the surrounding area.
